exclusions.name: Orange X / LemonX / Moon
exclusions.reason: Held as related endgame income-source/location context. It is not a separate location row until Phase 2 or later source work verifies a physical map location separate from the UFO / Alien route.

exclusions.name: Decorative buildings and normal props
exclusions.reason: Excluded unless a building hides buttons, gates progression, or connects to a permanent unlock.

exclusions.name: Badges, gamepasses, private servers, and raw Roblox media

meta.notes: First Tier Staircase is included because selllemons.com describes a spiral staircase that appears near the Republic area with purchasable buttons along the stairway. No acceptable direct location screenshots were found in the research pass, so row image fields stay empty.

items.name: Main plot / Lemon Stand
items.cardSummary: The main plot is the route anchor. It teaches the cash loop and gives you the first place to check after buying stand upgrades or decorations.
items.connectedSystem: Lemon Stand, first upgrades, cash drops, decoration gates, early automation
items.keyObjectsOrNpcs: Lemon Stand, Juicer, Cup Stand, Cash Register Automator, decoration purchases
items.rewardOrReason: Sets up the first income loop and reveals early buttons that can be missed if decoration gates are ignored.
items.travelNote: Treat the plot as the route anchor before moving to LemonDash, Depot, or later teleport arrows.
items.verification: Strong source support from the map overview and Lemon Stand map guide.

items.name: Lemon Depot / Trading edge
items.cardSummary: The Depot and Trading edge is the first major route split. Use it when the starter stand is no longer enough and you need wholesale or market income.
items.unlock: After the early stand and delivery route
items.connectedSystem: Lemon Depot, wholesale selling, Depot manager, Trading Post
items.keyObjectsOrNpcs: Depot station, multiplier panel, Depot manager, Trading Post entrance
items.rewardOrReason: Moves the run from starter clicking into wholesale income and the first major mid-game route split.
items.travelNote: Check inside and around the Depot after buying building pieces because new useful buttons may appear away from the previous purchase.
items.verification: Strong source support from the Depot map guide; exact unlock number is intentionally not guessed.

items.name: Hill Expansion
items.cardSummary: Hill Expansion turns the map into a climb. Each new layer can reveal later systems, so scan the new level before rushing away.
items.unlock: Unlocked after Depot and Trading progress
items.connectedSystem: Hill layers, Labs entrance, Robotics route, Republic route
items.keyObjectsOrNpcs: Layer unlock buttons, hill buildings, summit route, Labs and Robotics entrance
items.rewardOrReason: Opens the vertical late-game build path and the route toward the strongest normal progression systems.
items.travelNote: Treat the hill as a layered climb. Buy each layer, then walk the new level for hidden or newly revealed buttons.
items.verification: Strong source support from the Hill Expansion map guide.

items.name: Sewer Maze
items.cardSummary: The Sewer Maze is the first hidden route. It matters because levers, doors, and the Cosmic Vine path start the secret-key chain.
items.unlock: Enter from main-street manholes; Sewer Key route unlocks the Cosmic Vine gate
items.connectedSystem: Sewer Key, colored lever puzzle, Cosmic Cash Vine, Cosmic Farmer reward path
items.keyObjectsOrNpcs: Manholes, colored levers, colored doors, Sewer Key, Cosmic Cash Vine
items.rewardOrReason: Gives access to secret key progression and the Cosmic Vine path without turning the location card into a full puzzle walkthrough.
items.travelNote: Finish a key route before leaving because lever progress can reset. Use a fresh server between key routes if the levers behave strangely.
items.verification: Strong source support from Bloxron, selllemons.com, Pro Game Guides, and All Things How.

items.name: UFO / Alien route
items.cardSummary: The UFO and alien route is a secret endgame branch. It connects Sewer progress to Good Samaritan, the UFO Key, and later LemonX preparation.
items.unlock: Requires rebirth and investor progress before the UFO Key route can be completed
items.connectedSystem: UFO Key, alien NPC quest, Good Samaritan reward, investor bonus
items.keyObjectsOrNpcs: UFO Key, Homeless Alien or alien NPC, sewer levers, investor requirement
items.rewardOrReason: Connects the sewer puzzle chain to the permanent Good Samaritan investor bonus and later endgame preparation.
items.travelNote: Start from the sewer route, talk to the alien NPC at the required step, and keep Moon or LemonX context tied to this route unless the game sends you to a separate area.
items.verification: Strong support for the quest route from Bloxron, selllemons.com, Pro Game Guides, and All Things How; separate UFO area placement still needs clean screenshot confirmation.

items.name: First Tier Staircase
items.cardSummary: First Tier Staircase is a permanent endgame route near Republic progress. Save it for very late runs where staircase purchases are affordable.
items.unlock: About 1 trevigintillion cash near the Republic area, plus very late investor progress
items.connectedSystem: First Tier, spiral staircase, Ascension prerequisite, permanent progression
items.keyObjectsOrNpcs: First Tier button, spiral staircase, stairway purchase buttons
items.rewardOrReason: Adds a permanent stairway route that persists through Rebirth and Evolution and points toward Ascension.
items.travelNote: Look near the Republic area after reaching trevigintillion-scale progress. Buy the staircase buttons along the way before expecting the Ascension path to be complete.
items.verification: Included from direct source evidence that a spiral staircase appears near Republic with purchasable buttons along the stairway.
